response.sql: WITH standings_with_previous AS (SELECT cs.raceId, cs.wins, COALESCE(LAG(cs.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year ORDER BY r.round, r.raceId), 0) AS previous_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(s.wins - s.previous_wins) AS average_wins FROM standings_with_previous AS s JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = s.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), all_country_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_wins FROM country_averages), above_all AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.average_wins, ca.average_wins - m.mean_wins AS excess_over_all FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN all_country_mean AS m WHERE ca.average_wins > m.mean_wins), above_average_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_wins FROM above_all), final_countries AS (SELECT a.average_wins, a.excess_over_all, a.average_wins - m.mean_wins AS excess_over_above_average FROM above_all AS a CROSS JOIN above_average_mean AS m WHERE a.average_wins > m.mean_wins) SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_average_wins, AVG(excess_over_all) AS mean_excess_over_all, AVG(excess_over_above_average) AS mean_excess_over_above_average FROM final_countries;
